name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn. Two orders of mori soba are up」
Everyone's digging into the soba I carried out with such delight.
I didn't make it myself, yet it still makes me feel a little happy.
Looking at it that way, Yuugiri-an is practically sparkling with happiness, isn't it.
The old man is even sharper than usual today.
Everyone sheds the sweat of honest labor--though I'm not entirely sure if they even have sweat glands.
Let's pretend I didn't see that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. You've got a really great smile going there」

name: Synn
message: 「You're one to talk, Nanaka--you're livelier than ever today」
We give each other a high five for no particular reason.
Work is going smoothly. Workplace relationships are great, too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. You know, I kind of feel like something terrifying happened a little while ago, but」

name: Synn
message: 「Weird, right? I've got that same feeling」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, working hard and seeing the customers get happy over our soba just leaves me feeling so refreshed」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you're right. There's definitely nothing scary at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Let's make them happy with our soba」
We looked toward the doorway with our very best smiles.

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, you two certainly seem carefree, even with exams coming up so soon」

name: Misasagi
message: 「They're next week, so you really ought to keep the escapism in moderation」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I must say, that's hardly a proper attitude to take toward a paying customer」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That person over there with the terribly sulky look on her face should know what I mean」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... you're a regular here?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Regrettably, when it comes to me, I'm told I won't be called a regular until I've been coming for a hundred years」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which is why you're not a regular」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The inaka soba here has a wonderful firmness and is simply delicious. Besides, chatting with Nanaka is always such a delight」

name: Synn
message: 「You shouldn't say things like that just to tease Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka can't beat you, Senpai... so please don't tease her too much」

name: Paqy
message: 「Saying that just proves you lost, man」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Can't help it when it's a girl I like. Besides, it's not like I'm gonna strip her bare just 'cause I won」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nanaka-han. Wouldn't mind tutoring you again for the first time in a while, ya know?」
